title: 🏥 Shelbyville, IN Healthcare Hiring: Multiple Clinical Roles Open
text:
1 days ago Shelbyville’s healthcare scene is busy and growing, with solid options from rehab to primary care. If you’re licensed and ready to work, there are several roles here worth a closer look.
Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) Employer: Synchrony Rehab (Trilogy Health Services) Location: Shelbyville, IN Type: Full-time Salary: Not listed Weekly pay, health and dental after your first month, student loan repayment, and a competitive 401(k) match. Support seniors with hands-on therapy while working closely with a supervising PT in a team-focused, six-month "blue badge" training period.
Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) Employer: Synchrony Rehab (Trilogy Health Services) Location: Shelbyville, IN Type: Full-time Salary: Not listed Provide the full range of speech therapy services—assessment, treatment, and family education—in an interdisciplinary rehab setting. Ideal if you have a Master’s in Speech Language Pathology and an active or pending state SLP license and want strong orientation support.
Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) Employer: Waldron Rehabilitation and Healthcare Center Location: Shelbyville, IN Type: Full-time Salary: Not listed Hands-on nursing role where you provide direct resident care and supervise CNAs in a long-term care environment. Good fit if you hold an unencumbered LPN license , current CPR, and like a mix of bedside care, meds, and leadership.
